title: system examples

blocks.text: These repository examples run in the embedded playground with editable TypeScript, a live preview, an authored walkthrough, suggested experiments, detected requirements and related APIs. Entries that support other scenes instead of exporting a Scene are shown as source modules without a play control.
For a smaller scene with one learning goal, start with [Focused scene examples](/focused-examples).

summary: Run and study repository examples with editable source, live previews, authored explanations and related API guidance.
